...The body was still lying there.
It wasn't a pleasant sight.
I'd better get this over with quickly.{p}Now, what should I do?
rows.07:270ac:
I opened the notebook.
Inside were petty gripes written by Hino, Shindo and the others.
Spilled coffee on me.
Got barked at by a dog.
Hid my shoes.
Told a stupid joke.
Tapped me on the shoulder out of nowhere.
Was noisy when I was sleepy.
Has a vulgar laugh.
Never apologized.
Paid back the money I lent without interest.
Wouldn't let me copy their notes.
...Along with that petty nonsense, many people's names were written down.{p}
